_source: README Expected outcomes — E2E-79. commentHeader is attacker-adjacent text rendered into every comment the installation posts, and the overlay seeds it with a live XSS payload: `# Acme Review Bot [click](...) **bold**`. If escaping works the body carries the entity-encoded form; if it regresses the raw tag appears verbatim. That is a deterministic string test with a real security consequence. The tone/showWorkDone/checklist knobs need a cross-run comparison of the finding set and stay manual.
